detail: Personal company created 15 September 2008 (R.C.S. Paris; registered office 10 rue Lavoisier, 75008 Paris; NAF 63.91Z press-agency activities). Collects his book royalties, TV/radio fees and conference income; its corporate object was extended in 2021 to add book publishing, enabling self-publication of 'La France n'a pas dit son dernier mot'. Co-managed with his wife Mylène Zemmour (née Chichportich). Declared HATVP value €1,530,000 (31 Dec 2020). Named after Balzac's character Lucien de Rubempré.

entity: Éditions Rubempré (publishing imprint operated through Rubempré SARL)
detail: Self-publishing imprint used from 2021 to publish 'La France n'a pas dit son dernier mot'. Rubempré is party to a Paris Cour d'appel dispute with Éditions Albin Michel (proceedings noted 2025) over his publishing rights.

ownership_stake: n/a (political party, not a commercial holding)
detail: National-conservative party founded December 2021. Party/campaign financing is reported to the CNCCFP, separate from Zemmour's personal HATVP declaration; detailed party-loan figures were not confirmed in this research pass and should be sourced from CNCCFP campaign accounts.
